control_register_rule: smallest m in [ceil(log2 N), 2 ceil(log2 N)] for which the frozen continued-fraction exact-order success set is nonempty
aggregate_inference: equal-instance-weight paired hierarchical bootstrap; resample instances, then meta-repetitions within sampled instances
primary_gates: complete frozen instance family is used
all continued-fraction success sets are nonempty
response rank is five and tangent dimension is four
three-way charged budget gap is zero
intrinsic response and ideal multiplier are preserved
aggregate intrinsic-vs-reference hierarchical CI lower bound is positive
aggregate intrinsic-vs-random hierarchical CI lower bound is positive
aggregate intrinsic-vs-SPSA hierarchical CI lower bound is positive
intrinsic has positive mean advantage over random on at least two thirds of instances
intrinsic has positive mean advantage over SPSA on at least two thirds of instances
failure_policy: retain and report every failed primary gate and every per-instance result
boundary: Six small exact state-vector order-finding distributions in one shared synthetic implementation/noise family; not native-gate hardware, fault tolerance, cryptographic scale, universal Shor optimization, or asymptotic speedup.
